    <title>Videy.Design - Platform Free</title>
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.5.1/css/all.min.css">
    <style>
        :root {
            --bg-0: #0b0f19;
            --bg-1: #10162a;
            --bg-2: #161d35;
            --card-bg: #131a2e;
            --card-border: #232c48;
            --text-primary: #eef1fb;
            --text-secondary: #8a92b2;
            --primary: #6366f1;
            --primary-2: #818cf8;
            --accent: #22d3ee;
            --accent-2: #34d399;
            --gradient-primary: linear-gradient(135deg, #6366f1 0%, #22d3ee 100%);
            --gradient-secondary: linear-gradient(135deg, #10b981 0%, #34d399 100%);
            --gradient-glow: radial-gradient(circle at top left, rgba(99,102,241,0.35), transparent 60%);
            --shadow-light: 0 4px 12px -2px rgba(0,0,0,0.35);
            --shadow-medium: 0 12px 28px -8px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
            --shadow-heavy: 0 30px 60px -15px rgba(0,0,0,0.65);
            --shadow-glow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(99,102,241,0.4), 0 8px 24px -6px rgba(99,102,241,0.45);
        }

        * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

        body {
            font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif;
            background:
                var(--gradient-glow),
                radial-gradient(circle at bottom right, rgba(34,211,238,0.12), transparent 55%),
                var(--bg-0);
            background-attachment: fixed;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            line-height: 1.6;
            overflow-x: hidden;
        }

        /* Header */
        .header {
            background: rgba(11, 15, 25, 0.7);
            backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
            position: sticky;
            top: 0;
            z-index: 1000;
        }

        .nav {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            padding: 1.1rem 2rem;
            max-width: 1400px;
            margin: 0 auto;
        }

        .logo {
            font-size: 1.9rem;
            font-weight: 900;
            letter-spacing: -0.02em;
            background: var(--gradient-primary);
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
            background-clip: text;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.5rem;
        }

        .logo i { -webkit-text-fill-color: initial; color: var(--primary-2); }

        .upload-button {
            background: var(--gradient-primary);
            color: white;
            padding: 0.7rem 1.4rem;
            border-radius: 50px;
            text-decoration: none;
            font-weight: 600;
            font-size: 0.9rem;
            transition: all 0.25s ease;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-glow);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.5rem;
        }

        .upload-button:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); }

        /* Container */
        .container { max-width: 1400px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 2rem; }

        /* Banner */
        .donation-banner {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1b2440 0%, #101728 100%);
            border: 1px solid rgba(99,102,241,0.35);
            border-radius: 20px;
            padding: 2rem;
            margin-bottom: 2rem;
            text-align: center;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-medium);
        }

        .donation-banner::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            inset: -50%;
            background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(99,102,241,0.18) 0%, transparent 70%);
            animation: shimmer 4s ease-in-out infinite;
        }

        @keyframes shimmer {
            0%, 100% { transform: translateX(-30%) translateY(-10%); }
            50% { transform: translateX(30%) translateY(10%); }
        }

        .donation-content { position: relative; z-index: 1; }
        .donation-icon { font-size: 2.6rem; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 12px rgba(99,102,241,0.6)); }
        .donation-text h3 {
            font-size: 1.5rem; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.01em;
        }
        .donation-text p { color: var(--text-secondary); }

        .custom-btn {
            font-size: 1.05rem;
            color: #0b0f19;
            font-weight: 800;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #22d3ee, #6366f1);
            border: none;
            padding: 0.9rem 2rem;
            border-radius: 50px;
            margin-top: 1.25rem;
            cursor: pointer;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-glow);
            transition: all 0.25s ease;
        }

        .custom-btn:hover { transform: translateY(-3px) scale(1.03); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(34,211,238,0.5), 0 16px 30px -8px rgba(34,211,238,0.5); }

        /* Section Header */
        .section-header {
            display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;
            margin-bottom: 2rem; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 1rem;
        }

        .section-title {
            font-size: 1.8rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.02em;
            display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.6rem;
        }
        .section-title i { color: var(--accent); }

        .filter-buttons {
            display: flex; gap: 0.25rem;
            background: var(--card-bg);
            border: 1px solid var(--card-border);
            padding: 0.3rem; border-radius: 50px;
        }

        .filter-btn {
            padding: 0.65rem 1.35rem;
            border-radius: 50px;
            text-decoration: none;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            font-weight: 600;
            font-size: 0.9rem;
            transition: all 0.25s ease;
        }

        .filter-btn.active, .filter-btn:hover {
            background: var(--gradient-primary);
            color: white;
        }

        /* Video Grid */
        .video-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: 1.5rem;
            margin-bottom: 3rem;
        }

        .video-card {
            background: var(--card-bg);
            border-radius: 16px;
            overflow: hidden;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            border: 1px solid var(--card-border);
            position: relative;
            opacity: 0;
            animation: fadeInUp 0.5s ease forwards;
        }

        @keyframes fadeInUp {
            from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(14px); }
            to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
        }

        .video-card:hover {
            transform: translateY(-6px);
            border-color: rgba(99,102,241,0.6);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-glow);
        }

        .video-thumbnail {
            position: relative;
